# Interior Design

> Global design magazine and industry leader serving architecture and design professionals with curated projects, products, trends, and market research.

Interior Design is the premier publication for design professionals, featuring award-winning projects, product trends, firm rankings, and industry news. The site covers residential, hospitality, healthcare, and office design across major global markets including North America, Europe, and Asia.

## Key Topics

- interior design projects
- design awards
- top 100 firms
- healthcare design
- sustainability design
- hospitality design
- design trends
- product trends
- market research
- design firms
- firm revenue
- designer interviews
- design destinations
- CannonDesign
- Gensler

## Featured Content & Projects

- [Projects](https://interiordesign.net/projects): Showcase of top trending interior design projects across residential, hospitality, and office spaces.
- [HOMES](https://interiordesign.net/homes): Residential design stories and home projects showcasing global interior design excellence.
- [Products](https://interiordesign.net/products): Curated collection of trending interior design products including furniture, lighting, and textiles.
- [4 Must-See Design Destinations](https://interiordesign.net/projects/4-must-see-design-destinations): Feature article on inspiring global design destinations and cultural venues.
- [This Showstopping Staircase Doubles As A Work Of Art](https://interiordesign.net/projects/new-york-spiral-staircase-by-sheltonmindel-boy-2025): Best of Year winner feature on SheltonMindel's artistic spiral staircase design.
- [CannonDesign Reframes The Medical Workplace](https://interiordesign.net/projects/cannondesign-northwestern-medicine-faculty-office-center): Project feature on CannonDesign's healthcare workplace design in Chicago.

## Awards & Recognition

- [2025 Best of Year Award Winners](https://interiordesign.net/awards/best-of-year): 2025 Best of Year Awards recognizing top design projects and products of the year.

## Industry Research & Rankings

- [Unveiling Interior Design's 2025 Top 100 Giants](https://interiordesign.net/research/interior-designs-2025-top-100-giants): 2025 rankings of top 100 design firms with industry analysis and market research data.
- [A Look At Interior Design's 2026 Top 100 Giants](https://interiordesign.net/research/a-look-at-interior-designs-2026-top-100-giants): 2026 rankings of top 100 design firms with resilience and market analysis.
- [Interior Design Spotlights 2025 Healthcare Giants](https://interiordesign.net/research/interior-design-2025-healthcare-giants): 2025 healthcare design firms rankings with growth analysis and industry metrics.
- [Meet Interior Design's 2025 Sustainability Giants](https://interiordesign.net/research/interior-design-2025-sustainability-giants): 2025 sustainability-focused design firms rankings and impact analysis.
- [Introducing Interior Design's 2025 Rising Giants](https://interiordesign.net/research/interior-designs-2025-rising-giants): 2025 emerging design firms positioned for growth and creative innovation.
